name: Thread the Needle
steps: Start on all fours with your hands directly beneath your shoulders, knees beneath your hips, and spine neutral.
Slide one arm palm-up beneath your opposite arm while rotating your upper back smoothly until your shoulder and cheek near the floor.
Reverse gently to unwind your torso and reach that same arm upward toward the ceiling to open your chest.
Move smoothly back and forth through a comfortable range for the target duration, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your hips stacked evenly over your knees so the rotation happens cleanly through your upper back.
Exhale gently as you thread your arm under without forcing your shoulder painfully into the floor.
